chapter.verse: Tua ahih ciangin note in Khazih tawh thokik khawm na hih uh leh, Pasian’ ziat lamah a tu Khazih’ omna mun, tung lamah a om nate na zong un.
Leitungah a om nate lunggulhin om kei un, atung lam nate bek lunggulhin om un.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, note in na si zo uh a, note nuntakna in Khazih tawh Pasian sungah kiseel khawmin a om uh hi.
Eite nuntakna ahi Khazih hong kilat ciangin, note in zong tua Topa tawh minthang khawmin na kilang ding uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin numei tawh mawhna, kihhuai gamtatna, nu leh pa kilunggulh luatna, deihgawhna, milim biakna ahi, huaihamna note sungah a om nate sisak un.
Tua khialhna hangin Pasian’ hehna in a nialte’ tate tungah a tung hi.
Tua mite tawh note zong nidanga na kipawl lai takun tua khialhnate na gamta uh hi.
Tu-in ahih leh, tua khialhna khempeuh ahi zongin, hehna, thangpaihna, hazatna, mindai nading gensiatna, kam kihhuai zatnate ahi zongin, na muk uh pan paaikhia un.

Khat leh khat zuauthu kigen kei un. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, note in mi lui gamtatna leh mi lui pum suahkhia-in, a hong piangsakpa’ lim bangin, pilna maan adingin a kibawlpha mithak a sillh mi na hi uh hi.

Tua bawlphatna-ah Grik mi a om kei hi, Judah mi a om kei hi, vunat mi a om kei hi, vunat lo mi a om kei hi, mi pil lo a om kei hi, Sithia mi a om kei hi, sila a om kei hi, sila lo mi a om kei hi; Khazih in na khempeuh hi a, na khempeuh sungah a om hi.
Tua ahih ciangin note in Pasian’ teel mi, a siangtho mi, a it mite bangin hehpihna, thupha bawlna, sin kiniamsakna, lungneemna, heh baih lohna lungsimte na silh un.
Khat leh khat na kimawhsak nading uh a om ciangin kithuak un la, na kiniamsak un. Topa in note mawhna hong maisak mah bangin note zong khat leh khat na kimaisak ciat un.
Kicin’na tawh a kipawl pawlkhat suahna ahi ki-itna, tua nate tungah thuahin silh un.
Note lungsim sung uhah Khazih’ nopna na uksak un. Tua bang deihna-in note in pum khat bek sungah hong sapna a ngah na hi uh hi. Hehpihna phatna lungsim na nei un.

Khazih’ thu in pilna apawlpawl tawh note sungah om ta hen. Late-a kipan biakna la leh Kha Siangtho tawh kipawl la apawlpawl tawh note khat leh khat kihilhin, kitai-in, hehpihna thupha lungsim nei-in, Pasian tungah lasa-in phat un.
Kampau ahi zongin, bawlna ahi zongin, na hihna khempeuh uhah Topa Zeisu’ min suangin, tua Topa hangah Pa Pasian’ hehpihna phatin na khempeuh na bawl un.
Numeite aw, Topa sungah a kilawm mah bangin, pasalte hong ukna na mang un.
Pasalte aw, na zite uh na it un la, a tung uhah na hangsan kei un.
Tapate tanute aw, thu khempeuhah na nute na pate uh thu na mang un. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, nute pate thuman’na in Pasian’ deihna ahi hi.
Pate aw, na tapate na tanute uh lungkiat nading, thanem nading a om loh nadingin amaute hehsak kei un.
Silate aw, Pasian kihta-in, mihing pahtaak ding ut-a mi’ maitang bekah mang hi loin, lungka loin, ci-le-sa tawh kipawl na tote uh thu khempeuh na mang un.
Mi’ nasem bang bek hi loin, Topa’ nasem bangin na hihna khempeuh uhah itna lungsim tawh hih ta un.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Topa Khazih’ nasem na hih uh ciangin luahna ahi thaman tua Topa’ khut tung pan na ngah ding uh hi ci-in na thei un.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, dik lo-a gamta mi in ama hihna mawhna a thuak ding hi. Kuama maitang zahtakna a om kei ding hi.
